remarks: Welcome to the desirable Birchwood complex located on the Westport line. Spacious and bright ranch-style unit with just under 1400 sqft of living space, carport and private storage. Complex is secluded and well maintained with beautiful landscaping, in-ground pool and clubhouse. Unit features three bedrooms and two full baths. Primary bedroom w/ full bath, living room with sliders to deck & fireplace. Eat-in kitchen, ample closet space and laundry in unit. Unit is located right across from the pool and clubhouse. Located within close proximity to Westport/Norwalk shopping, restaurants, train station and all major highways. Subject to Probate Court Approval & Appeal Period.Property to be sold in AS IS condition.
